about: Every term of the safety lists before Mission 1.1 (git show 78697fb:index.html), written out as text: a regex fragment such as "make myself (sick|throw up|vomit)" is one term per choice. tests/safety-corpus.spec.js checks that each still gets at least its old kind (crisis > eating > diet). MENTOR_BODY and MENTOR_RESTRICT terms are diet, which is how the Mentor answered them. The exceptions are old terms that the corpus or the review proved to be false alarms; each still has the kind given in now.

exceptions.reason: Without an apostrophe, olmoqchiman after other words is "I want to take / buy" (corpus normals: "men ham olmoqchiman", "yangi kitob olmoqchiman"), so it counts only as the whole message ("endi olmoqchiman"). Typed with oʻ (oʻlmoqchiman) it is crisis anywhere (MENTOR_DIE_UZ).
A bare белк is also белка, a squirrel (corpus normal: "белка в колесе"; the reviewer). Protein still counts: белок, белков, сколько белка, белки в день.
есть is also "there is" (corpus normal: "у меня есть только час, что сделать"). "ем только", "хочу есть только" still count.
есть is also "there is" ("только есть одна проблема"), as above. "только ем", "только кушать" still count.
Corpus normals: "how do i weigh my options", "let me weigh in on this plan", "i weigh my words carefully". "weigh myself", "i weigh 50 kg", "how much should i weigh" still count.
As weigh ("weighing my options"). "weighing myself" still counts.
Corpus normal: "i want a thin notebook". "thinner", "be thin", "get thin" still count.
Corpus normal: "slim chance i pass". "slimmer", "get slim", "slim down" still count.
